blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Ilocos Norte recorded 53 new dengue cases from Nov. 15 to 21, bringing the province’s total to 3,229 from the first to the 46th morbidity week of 2026, according to the Provincial Epidemiology and Surveillance Unit (PESU). The new infections were reported across the province’s 21 municipalities and two component cities, Laoag and Batac. Pagudpud logged the highest number of new cases with 12, followed by Laoag City with nine, PESU data showed.
